name: MALTX
tree:
malt_cross (levelprogram) -- a brewery yard at night, three levels deep in one footprint
  yard (assembly) -- the brewery yard: cobbles, open to the night
    cobbles (room) -- the yard proper
    hatch (room) -- the malt hatch: the floor you can see the cellar through
  brewhouse (assembly) -- the working building: mash floor below, malt loft above
    ground (assembly) -- the mash floor, and the foot of the stair
      mash (room) -- coppers and a drain; the loudest room here
      stairfoot (room) -- where the stair down from the loft arrives
      mash_door (room) -- through the stairwell wall, at the bottom
      yard_door (room) -- out to the yard, through 512 units of outside wall
    first (assembly) -- the malt loft; the alley between the buildings is the way off
      loft (room) -- boarded floor and sacks; the way off is east, through the stair landing
      landing (room) -- the head of the stair
      loft_door (room) -- through the stairwell wall, at the top
  kiln (assembly) -- where the malt is dried: warmer and dirtier than the brewhouse
    ground (assembly) -- the drying floor and the foot of its stair
      floor (room) -- perforated, hot, and the way in from the yard
      stairfoot (room) -- the foot of the kiln stair
      door (room) -- into the stairwell
      yard_door (room) -- out to the yard, through 512 units of outside wall
    first (assembly) -- the kiln loft, reached from its own stair
      loft (room) -- one long room over the drying floor; the alley is west
      landing (room) -- the head of the stair
      door (room) -- out of the stairwell onto the loft
  alley (assembly) -- the covered close between the buildings: both lofts, then the yard
    ground (assembly) -- the foot of the alley stair, and the door onto the cobbles
      stairfoot (room) -- where the alley stair arrives at street height
      yard_door (room) -- out to the yard, between the two street doors, not above either
    first (assembly) -- the head of the alley, fed from both lofts through their side walls
      landing (room) -- the alley landing: east from the malt loft, west from the kiln loft
      brew_door (room) -- through the brewhouse's east wall, off the malt-stair landing
      kiln_door (room) -- through the kiln's west wall, the side of the loft
  porches (assembly) -- side porches onto the yard, and the windows that look out over it
    west_door (room) -- out of the malt loft through its west wall
    west (room) -- the west porch: along the yard's west wall, onto the gantry
    east_door (room) -- French doors out of the kiln loft, east of the street door, onto the balcony
    east_run (room) -- the balcony along the kiln's south wall; it does not open to the yard
    east (room) -- the east porch: into the yard through its east wall, not its north
    brew_window (room) -- a window in the malt loft's south wall, west of the street door
  store (assembly) -- a low range along the south of the yard; its roof is walked on
    inside (assembly) -- the store itself
      shed (room) -- barrels, and the way through to the yard
      stairhead (room) -- the head of the cellar stair, walled off from the store floor
      stair_door (room) -- through the store's south wall, to the stairhead
      door (room) -- in from the yard, through the store's north wall
    roof (assembly) -- the store roof: level with both lofts, and where the gantry lands
      leads (room) -- walked over the store, open to the sky, reached by the stair inside it
      tower_head (room) -- off the malt tower onto the store roof, facing the gantry
  cellar (assembly) -- the malt cellar: the whole reason the yard has a hatch in it
    vault (room) -- one long vault, under the yard
    under_hatch (room) -- what the hatch looks down into
    passage (room) -- a low run south under the yard, toward the store
    landing (room) -- the foot of the stair up into the store
    tower_foot (room) -- out of the cellar into the foot of the malt tower
